statement: A general ceasefire covering the entire Russia-Ukraine line of contact takes effect between 2026-11-13 and 2027-02-15, confirmed by both the Russian and Ukrainian governments.
resolution: TRUE if Reuters and AP both report a ceasefire covering the whole front line took effect between 2026-11-13 and 2027-02-15, confirmed by both governments; energy-only, humanitarian, holiday or localized truces do not count.
failure_condition: No ceasefire covering the entire line of contact and confirmed by both governments took effect between 2026-11-13 and 2027-02-15.

statement: The 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield, FRED series DGS10, closes at or above 5.25 percent on at least one trading day between 2026-11-13 and 2027-01-29. Reference: 5.07 percent on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if the highest FRED DGS10 daily value dated 2026-11-13 through 2027-01-29 is 5.25 or higher; FALSE otherwise. Reference: 5.07 percent on the packet date.
failure_condition: Every DGS10 daily value from 2026-11-13 through 2027-01-29 is below 5.25 percent.
